title: lepturus pulchellus
intro: Lepturus pulchellus, commonly known as slender grass or finger grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. Lepturus pulchellus contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Lepturus pulchellus may also include its ability to reduce oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
